svg.title: From the source identity to the manuscript's tables
svg.desc: Four stages connect the code to the manuscript. The runtime source, the registered configurations and the Arrhenius site profile define a run; one Slurm job executes the eight sealed stages and leaves a run directory whose stage manifests chain the SHA-256 of every file; the run-archive contract packs, verifies, deposits and ingests that directory into runs/index.json, and the experiments outside the eight stages enter as measurement-record sets traced value by value to their raw logs; the paper build reads only ingested or bundled runs and deposited record sets and writes the tables and figures. make verify runs every check on each push. The seven bundled synthetic runs travel the same chain under a synthetic banner. A sealed chain shows that a run's bytes are the bytes it wrote; who ran it, when, and whether it is the run behind a reported number are declared, not proven.

text.tspan: From the source identity to the manuscript's tables
One chain: sealed run → verified archive → ingested index → run-derived tables and figures
1 · SOURCE AND CONFIGURATION · what every run seals
split rule, seeds, folds, margins ε
2 · EXECUTION · one Slurm job per run (docs/ARRHENIUS.md)
each stage writes a manifest with
the SHA-256 of its files; later
3 · DEPOSIT · run archives (docs/RUN_ARCHIVES.md) and measurement records (records/)
T1 T2 S4 S12 S12c S13
snapshot of source + resolved configuration + profile
verified archives and record sets (runs/, records/)
5 · CHECKED ON EVERY PUSH · make verify
registry-check · fingerprint · audit-artifacts · example-views-check · example-paper-check · manifests-check ·
The seven bundled synthetic runs travel the same chain into paper/generated/examples/ under a synthetic banner;
official archives are built into paper/generated/official/ and compared with the manuscript.
A sealed chain shows that a run's bytes are the bytes it wrote. Who ran it, when, and whether it is the run behind a reported
number are declared in the result binding, not proven by the hash.
